name: App Store
tagline: The apps of your workspace, and what they run on this computer

offers.label: Refresh
offers.description: Reads the workspace's sources again: the registries, Flathub and this computer's Flatpak

offers.label: Begin reading
offers.description: A job that changes the catalogue itself rather than one app, followed as the read is: its end

offers.label: Take catalogue
offers.description: The catalogue one read found, put into the workspace: apps in the order the sources gave

offers.label: Read flathub
offers.description: Reads Flathub's catalogue over its own search API, a page at a time, and keeps every app

offers.label: Absorb text
offers.description: One app as a source wrote it, read and kept where it stands: an app this workspace already

offers.label: Absorb remote text
offers.description: One repository as a source wrote it, kept where it stands.

offers.label: Refresh remotes
offers.description: Reads this computer's Flatpak repositories again.

offers.label: Add repository
offers.description: Adds a Flatpak repository to this workspace.

offers.label: Update all apps
offers.description: Updates every app the workspace runs and its sources offer a newer version of.

offers.label: Install reviewed package
offers.description: Installs the package someone just reviewed, after the person read its details.

offers.label: Open link
offers.description: Opens a `tilo-store:` link: the app (`tilo-store:app/<identity>`), or runtime

offers.label: Review an app's runtime
offers.description: Reads a runtime's exact signed offer, so its page says what installing it would run.

offers.label: Record moderation case
offers.description: Records the registry's case for an app, as a refresh read it.
